## v0.13.2 更新内容 / What's new

- **修复 macOS 上搜索框无法输入中文**：用输入法打完拼音后，按空格选词或回车上屏，文字会立刻消失，页面也退回上一页。现在选词上屏后才开始搜索，打拼音的过程中不再拿字母去搜；组字时按 Esc 只取消拼音，不会清空已有的搜索。
- 装着 v0.13.0 或 v0.13.1 的应用可以在应用内一键更新；v0.12.0 及更早的版本仍需手动下载安装。

- **Fixed typing Chinese in the search box on macOS**: after typing pinyin with an input method, pressing Space or Return to commit made the text vanish and jumped back to the previous page. Search now starts once the text is committed, so pinyin letters are no longer searched while composing; Esc during composition only cancels the composition and keeps your search.
- Apps on v0.13.0 or v0.13.1 can update in-app; v0.12.0 and earlier still need a manual install.
